question: Must Bhairava as lord of the lamp be ritually propitiated?
premises: The lamp-lord is named as Bhairava.
A prescriptive act of propitiation is enjoined.
The instruction is formally concluded with iti.
inference: Therefore Bhairava in the form of the lamp-lord is to be propitiated.
plain_english: Thus one should propitiate Bhairava as the lord of the lamp.
